title: ART of PIV: Agentic Real-Time Particle Image Velocimetry for Active Flow Control
title_zh: ART of PIV：面向主动流动控制的智能体化实时粒子图像测速

paragraphs.en: 提出ART of PIV智能体化实时粒子图像测速框架，自动选择流程配置，兼顾测量精度与实时性。 Particle image velocimetry (PIV) measures fluid motion from images of tracer particles, but its accuracy depends on choices throughout the estimation pipeline, including image preprocessing, flow estimation, and postprocessing. These choices are typically left to expert tuning, and a fixed configuration can become less accurate as conditions change. This matters especially when PIV supplies feedback for real-time control, where measurements must be both accurate and fast, and flow conditions vary. We introduce ART of PIV -- short for Agentic Real-Time and also a nod to the art of tuning a PIV pipeline -- which automates pipeline choice for each image pair. A learned agent selects a configuration according to a chosen measurement objective from a library assembled for a specified speed budget. Across cross-correlation, classical optical-flow, and learning-based estimators, ART of PIV reduces average end-point error (AEPE) by 12.2-22.4 % relative to the best single estimator at matched speed, with gains extending to 1000-4000 image pair/s. In a simulated local velocity regulation task, it reduces mean normalized closed-loop cost by 13.24-13.59 percentage points relative to a tuned fixed estimator, with the same classical controller in both cases. In a tabletop water channel, we illustrate two ways to tune ART of PIV for a fluidic pinball of three rotating cylinders: selecting between complementary optical-flow tunings for accuracy, and selecting regions of interest with coherent rotation or shear using a common flow estimator. For the first variant, we train a DreamerV3 reinforcement learning controller directly in the physical world and demonstrate tracking of a prescribed flow field in the wake of a fluidic pinball.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ART of PIV——智能体化实时粒子图像测速框架，可自动选择流程配置，兼顾测量精度与实时性。粒子图像测速（PIV）通过示踪粒子图像测量流体运动，但其精度取决于整个估计流程中的各项选择，包括图像预处理、流场估计和后处理。 这些选择通常交由专家手动调优，而固定配置在条件变化时可能变得不够准确。 当PIV为实时控制提供反馈时，这一点尤为重要，因为测量必须既准确又快速，且流动条件不断变化。 我们提出ART of PIV——它是Agentic Real-Time（智能体化实时）的缩写，也致敬了PIV流程调优的“艺术”——可为每对图像自动选择流程。 学习得到的智能体根据所选的测量目标，从为特定速度预算组建的配置库中选择一种配置。 在互相关、经典光流和基于学习的估计器中，ART of PIV在相同速度下相对于最佳单一估计器，将平均端点误差（AEPE）降低了12.2–22.4%，且增益可延伸至1000–4000对图像/秒。 在一个模拟的局部速度调节任务中，相对于经调优的固定估计器，它将平均归一化闭环成本降低了13.24–13.59个百分点，两种情况使用相同的经典控制器。 在一个桌面水槽实验中，我们展示了为三旋转圆柱组成的流体弹珠台调优ART of PIV的两种方式：在互补的光流调优之间进行选择以获得精度，以及使用同一流场估计器选择具有一致旋转或剪切的感兴趣区域。 对于第一种变体，我们直接在物理世界中训练DreamerV3强化学习控制器，并演示了在流体弹珠台尾流中对指定流场的跟踪。
